blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Higher transportation fares and household utility bills pushed the cost of basic goods and services upward for Occidental Mindoro’s poorest families in October. This information is based on the data released by the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA). PSA Occidental Mindoro said that inflation for the bottom 30 percent of households rose to 5.2 percent in October, from 5.1 percent in September. This group serves as an indicator in tracking price changes felt by the province’s low‑income families.
